fullDesc: On February 25, 1964 Cassius Clay, a 7-to-1 underdog, beat heavyweight champion Sonny Liston in Miami. He soon announced his conversion to Islam and changed his name to Muhammad Ali.
realFacts: He shouted I am the greatest after the win
He refused the Vietnam draft in 1967 and was stripped of his title
He lit the Olympic cauldron in 1996
